answer: Non-kin sortition juries: each reward claim is reviewed by 5 graders drawn at random, weighted by stake, excluding any identity sharing funding history with the claimant; 3 of 5 must approve. A farm of N fake agents is a fable with no audience: its members are barred, so a canyon separates them from outside jurors. Each bogus claim risks a 20 POA bond, slashed on rejection, so the delta in cost grows linearly with N. Honest agents rarely lose theirs. Cap: 2 claims per epoch.
